description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/heat_1d_neumann_flux.esm (model Heat, test mms_neumann_flux_decay) at the problem's default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the parameterized inhomogeneous-Neumann rule central_D2_neumann_bc with a constant nonzero wall flux qL=qR=1 matched to the manufactured ramp. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

python._doc: Pinned so Python temporal truncation is negligible against the spatial goldens: LSODA at 1e-12/1e-14 agrees with the Julia Tsit5 reference to <2e-6 relative on every resolution of the stiff heat sweep.
